findings.title: Unauthenticated environment job API — any local caller can enqueue Blender work
findings.evidence: No auth middleware, API key, or session checks under app/. POST /v1/environment/jobs accepts EnvironmentJobRequest from any client that can reach the listener. Default host is 127.0.0.1:8741 (loopback). Grep for auth/API_KEY/Bearer/middleware in app/ returned no matches.
findings.impact: Any local process can force real Blender execution (CPU/disk fill under storage/generated_quarantine), cancel only queued jobs, and list templates/modules. Mis-bind to non-loopback elevates to LAN abuse.
findings.wo_mapping: WO acceptance does not require auth for P0E; still in-scope Red hunt category authority_bypass.
findings.residual_vs_docs: Aligned with docs/SECURITY.md P0 local-trust model; not a claim of production sandbox.
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Require local capability token or named-pipe peer identity before create; keep loopback bind fail-closed.

findings.title: Shared max_active_jobs=1 lease is asymmetric — Character create ignores environment active receipts
findings.evidence: EnvironmentJobService._bridge_busy scans environment_job_receipt.json (QUEUED/RUNNING) AND character job_receipt.json AND probes runner._worker_gate. CharacterJobService._create_locked never checks environment receipts or busy; always allocates QUEUED and schedules execute. Separate _create_lock objects per service — not a single Bridge create lock. Shared BoundedSemaphore only serializes Blender at execute time.
findings.impact: WO criterion 5 ('all jobs share one Bridge-wide active lease') is only partially true: concurrent Character+Environment creates can both queue while an environment job is active; env-side 409 busy is not mutual. Unbounded queue of Blender work possible; gate still prevents dual simultaneous Blender processes in-process.
findings.classification: FACT (source asymmetry) + INFERENCE (race under concurrent HTTP)
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Character create path must call the same Bridge-wide busy scan; single create lock spanning both services.

findings.title: Canonical fingerprint includes request_id and idempotency_key — same key + same body with new request_id false-conflicts
findings.evidence: canonical_request_fingerprint dumps full EnvironmentJobRequest via model_dump(mode='json'), which includes request_id and idempotency_key. Idempotency path compares full fingerprint; therefore a retry that preserves idempotency_key and semantic body but rotates request_id raises IdempotencyConflictError (409) instead of stable replay.
findings.impact: Breaks standard idempotency-key semantics (identity fields should be outside body fingerprint). Clients that generate new request_id per attempt with fixed key get permanent collision; WO criterion 4 only tested exact full-body replay including same request_id.
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Fingerprint exclude request_id (and possibly idempotency_key); keep request_id uniqueness as separate exact-replay gate.

findings.title: expected_bridge_revision accepted but never enforced against server revision
findings.evidence: Field expected_bridge_revision is required (ge=0) and is copied into internal_spec, but _validate_registries only checks registry_version, template/module/profile/terrain allowlist — no comparison to a server bridge revision constant or settings value.
findings.impact: Stale-revision clients are not fail-closed; weakens revision-binding authority pattern used elsewhere in AIdle (commit/AGM).
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Pin server bridge_revision; reject mismatch before queue.

findings.title: build_spec.sha256 written as evidence but never re-verified before Blender execution
findings.evidence: create writes build_spec.internal.json then build_spec.sha256. _run_real/_build_real_command read build_spec path and invoke Blender without hashing the file and comparing to build_spec.sha256. Worker trusts server_output_dir and allowed_operations from that file.
findings.impact: TOCTOU window between create and execute: any process with write access to storage/jobs can alter internal_spec (ops, paths within env roots, placements) while receipt fingerprint remains original. Integrity evidence is post-hoc only.
findings.classification: FACT (no verify call) + INFERENCE (requires jobs_root write collusion)
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Re-hash and compare before subprocess; refuse on mismatch.

findings.title: Stuck QUEUED/RUNNING environment receipts permanently block new env jobs (no reaper/TTL)
findings.evidence: has_active treats any environment_job_receipt with state QUEUED or RUNNING as busy forever. No TTL, orphan reaper, or crash recovery. Process kill after QUEUED write leaves durable busy forever until manual receipt edit.
findings.impact: Availability denial for /v1/environment/jobs after crash mid-flight; character path may still enqueue (see F02).
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Age-out or fail-closed reaper for stale active receipts; document operator recovery.

findings.title: Secondary registry identifiers (height_profile_id, material_id, camera_template_id) not validated against server registries
findings.evidence: Pattern-validated strings for height_profile_id/material_id/camera_template_id pass schema; _validate_registries does not resolve them. P0E worker ignores them and hardcodes terrain/camera — mitigates execution risk for this probe.
findings.impact: Incomplete fail-closed registry binding for future worker paths that honor those fields; clients can assert false provenance in request body.
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Registry-require or forbid unknown secondary ids; reject until registered.

findings.title: Client may disable save_blend / export_glb_modules / render_preview; max_materials not enforced post-run
findings.evidence: Only export_scene_manifest and generate_validation_report are Literal[True]. save_blend/export_glb_modules/render_preview remain optional bools. _verify_real_outputs skips optional artifacts when false. Clamped max_materials is stored in internal_spec but _verify_real_outputs never checks material count.
findings.impact: Jobs can reach QUARANTINED_COMPLETE without dual visual artifacts (blend/glb/preview); materials budget is advisory only. Real probe used all true — acceptance #9 path OK, general API weaker.
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: For STARTER_REALM P0E, require visual triad; enforce max_materials in verification.

findings.title: No automated test for Bridge-wide character+environment mutual lease exclusion
findings.evidence: ENV tests cover schema reject, unknown registry, idempotency same-body replay, budget schema cap, mock quarantine paths, real-command flags, missing-artifact fail-closed. No test creates concurrent character-job while environment QUEUED/RUNNING or asserts EnvironmentBusyError when character active. Blue acceptance_map criterion 5 cites Settings.max_active_jobs le=1 and _worker_gate usage without mutual create-path test.
findings.impact: Evidence gap for WO criterion 5; Purple should not treat criterion as fully proven from current pytest alone.
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Add TestClient race/sequence tests for cross-kind busy.

findings.title: Network deny remains policy marker only (TARGET_HARDENING residual)
findings.evidence: AIDLE_NETWORK_POLICY=deny set in worker env when settings.disable_network; no OS firewall/container isolation in code. SECURITY.md and Blueprint 07 explicitly mark dedicated OS account, egress deny, durable multi-process lease as not implemented.
findings.impact: Blender/Python retain OS account network capability; do not claim sandbox complete.
findings.recommendation_for_blue_only: Keep labeled TARGET_HARDENING; do not promote to implemented without OS evidence.
